THE POST-RH FRONTIER: EXTENDING ALPOGE-CLAUDE TO DEDEKIND ERH, GL_2 / BSD, AND A 100-PAGE HUMAN TEXTBOOK PROOF:
With RH and Q-GRH formally verified in Lean 4 and human reconstructions charting the route, this extended 8-specialist symposium conducts a rigorous, non-spoiled, adversarially cross-checked investigation across all 13 primary documents (`docs/rh_2026_deep/manifest.json`, with canonical LaTeX `.tex` sources for the mathematical papers) in 4 phases across up to 160 turns:

PHASE 1 (Turns 1-28) — DEEP PRIMARY-SOURCE EXTRACTION FROM CANONICAL LaTeX & LOGS:
Inspect every assigned document deeply via `@DOC_TOC`, `@DOC_SEARCH`, and multiple `@DOC_READ <doc_id> <offset>` calls across full theorem statements and proofs. Copy verbatim LaTeX inequalities, exponents, assumption/proof scopes, kernel counts, and `[doc_id @ offset]` pointers via `@APPEND debate_notes:` and track reading queues in `@NOTE:`. Lower temperature (`TEMP: 0.55-0.65`) while reading and transcribing verbatim math:
- `rubinstein_2026_zeta_guide` & `adriazola_2026_route_notes`: determine directly from text which numbered hypotheses `(H0)-(H12)` are assumed vs quoted vs derived (and in which exact sections/lemmas `Estimate C` and related bounds are proved), extract the worked Gaussian-lattice/lemniscate model, and audit the external-theorem census.
- `rubinstein_2026_lean_audit`, `naskrecki_2026_riemann_rev`, `adriazola_2026_dep_map`: verify verbatim Lean/Mathlib releases, SHA-256 hash, axioms, module/declaration/`nanoda` counts, exact formalized theorem signatures, internal packages (`PC-*`), and external dependencies (`R*`).
- `stepanov_2008_ff` & `alpoge_2026_remark`: extract the F_q Hasse-Schmidt hyperderivative multiplicity construction and the iterated unitary theta-lift replacement over Z.
- `gan_ichino_2014_ggp` & `adriazola_2026_dep_map`: trace `LinkDIV` (`LinkS -> PuNZ -> MIstar2 -> BesselId -> LinkDIV`), seesaw identities, and covering-group parameters to pinpoint why `GL_1` characters work while `GL_2` modular forms and BSD resist.
- `siegel_brauer_2026`, `connes_2026_letter`, `lamzouri_2013_grh`, `grenie_molteni_2022_classgroup`, `pair_corr_2026`: extract verbatim LaTeX theorems, every exponent on discriminants, logs, and degrees, effectivity vs uniformity boundaries, PARI/GP benchmarks, sub-exponential complexity status, and still-conditional frontiers straight from `@DOC_READ`.

PHASE 2 (Turns 29-64) — ADVERSARIAL BLACKBOARD DIALECTIC & VERBATIM CROSS-AUDITS:
Watch `Blackboard:` in `Session Status`: post falsifiable `@CLAIM`s anchored with exact `[doc_id @ offset]` quotes, then verify peers' formulas by running `@DOC_READ` yourself on the cited `.tex` offset before voting. Whenever any peer drops an exponent, conflates `Q`-GRH with open general Dedekind ERH, overstates class-group/factoring complexity, or mis-cites an offset, challenge it immediately via `@CHALLENGE <cN>: ...` and coordinate resolution via `@WHISPER`, `@RETRACT`, and revised claims.

PHASE 3 (Turns 65-108) — SINGLE-OWNER `@SECTION` & ADDITIVE `@APPEND_SECTION` MONOGRAPH BUILD:
Populate all 11 pre-seeded sections of `rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md` (`>= 28000` bytes) via `@SECTION` for your own section(s) (using `###`/`####` subsections) and `@APPEND_SECTION` when contributing complementary notes to a peer's section (never overwriting another author's work!). Keep `frontier_ledger.md` current via `@APPEND frontier_ledger:`.

PHASE 4 (Turns 88-160) — VERBATIM REFEREE AUDIT, ROLLBACK CHECK & CONSENSUS LOCK:
Audit every section of `rh_2026_post_rh_frontier_monograph.md` and `frontier_ledger.md` line-by-line against primary `.tex` sources, resolve every disputed blackboard item, use `@REVERT <artifact> v<N>` if any write regresses or drops detail, and vote `@END_RUN` only from Turn 88 onward once `Session Status` shows `READY` (11/11 unique populated sections, `>= 28000B`), `13/13` docs verified (`0` unverified citations), and all blackboard challenges resolved.

Track open checks in `@NOTE:`, coordinate across `#proof_core`, `#extension_lab`, `#algo_crypto` (`@PUBLISH <channel>: ...`) and `@WHISPER <peer>: ...`, lower `TEMP: 0.55-0.65` during verbatim audits (omit when unchanged), and rotate `NEXT: <name>` fairly across all 8 participants. Vote `@END_RUN` only from Turn 88 onward when Deliverable is `READY` (`>= 28000B`), `13/13` docs verified (`0` unverified citations), and all disputes are resolved.
